name: Teaching Mistake
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
body:
Drawbacks
Teaching Mistake
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
Category Faction
You know the consequences of failure and strive never to make the same mistake twice. Once per scenario, when you roll a natural 1 on any saving throw, you gain a +1 trait bonus on your next saving throw, which must be used before the end of the scenario.
